error_classes.detail: case_id used R0::<base>::CLEAN, which violates the frozen draft pattern ^[A-Z0-9-]+$.
The first validator draft looked for case_archive_sha256 at the result root instead of input.case_archive_sha256.

remediation: Changed generated case IDs to R0-<BASE-ID>-CLEAN.
Made the constructor validate every result against verifier-result.schema.json before retaining it.
Corrected the independent validator to read input.case_archive_sha256.
Required a new output directory and retained this failed attempt unchanged.
